nodes.rationale: Uses System.Security.Cryptography.ProtectedData instead of sync-over-async; keys migrated from old settings automatically.

nodes.label: Device updates only on UI thread via DispatcherQueue
nodes.norm_label: device updates only on ui thread via dispatcherqueue
nodes.rationale: MQTT callbacks and timers run on background threads; Device is INotifyPropertyChanged bound to UI, so mutations must be marshalled to the UI thread.

nodes.label: PowerHub Android App (reference implementation)
nodes.rationale: Omniroute is a port of PowerHub; when protocol logic is unclear, the Android app is the source of truth and protocols are ported one-to-one.

nodes.label: Fire-once notification rules with hysteresis
nodes.rationale: Mirrors Android logic: a rule triggers once until its condition clears, avoiding notification spam.

nodes.label: Unpackaged self-contained exe (WindowsPackageType=None)
nodes.rationale: No MSIX: avoids certificate, developer mode and installed Windows App Runtime; system had only framework 1.5 without DDLM/Main so framework-dependent exe did not start. Consequence: ApplicationData/Windows.Storage unavailable, use Data/LocalStore.
